title: Ontario Grade 10 Foundations of Mathematics (MFM2P) — Success Criteria

overalls.title: Similar Triangles
overalls.description: use their knowledge of ratio and proportion to investigate similar triangles and solve problems related to similarity

specifics.description: I can identify and apply properties of similar triangles to solve problems in realistic situations.

overalls.title: Right Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: solve problems involving right triangles, using the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem

specifics.description: I can use the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem to solve problems involving right triangles.
I can describe how trigonometry is applied in real-world occupations and everyday contexts.

overalls.title: Surface Area, Volume, and Measurement
overalls.description: solve problems involving the surface areas and volumes of three-dimensional figures, and use the imperial and metric systems of measurement

specifics.description: I can solve measurement problems using both the imperial and metric systems, including conversions between them.
I can solve problems involving the surface area and volume of prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, and spheres.

overalls.title: Algebraic Equations
overalls.description: manipulate and solve algebraic equations, as needed to solve problems

specifics.description: I can solve first-degree equations and determine the value of a variable using formulas.

overalls.title: Graphing and Equations of Lines
overalls.description: graph a line and write the equation of a line from given information

specifics.description: I can graph lines by hand and determine the equation of a line from its graph, slope, and points.
I can connect the slope of a line to rate of change and explain the meaning of m and b in y = mx + b.

overalls.title: Systems of Linear Equations
overalls.description: solve systems of two linear equations, and solve related problems that arise from realistic situations

specifics.description: I can solve systems of linear equations graphically and algebraically using substitution or elimination.
I can solve real-world problems by modelling situations with systems of linear equations.

strands.name: Quadratic Relations of the Form y = ax² + bx + c

overalls.title: Quadratic Expressions
overalls.description: manipulate algebraic expressions, as needed to understand quadratic relations

specifics.description: I can expand, simplify, and factor quadratic expressions including binomials, trinomials, and differences of squares.
I can identify the key features of a parabola including the vertex, axis of symmetry, and intercepts.
I can collect data that forms a quadratic relation and connect algebraic and graphical representations.

overalls.title: Interpreting Graphs of Quadratics
overalls.description: solve problems by interpreting graphs of quadratic relations

specifics.description: I can solve problems by interpreting graphs of quadratic relations, including determining maximum values and interpreting experimental data.
I can connect the key features of a quadratic graph to the real-world situation it represents.
